summary: Frontend-only i18n verification pass across EN, DE, AR on all major pages (Login, Dashboard, Orders, OrderDetail, OrderCreate, Inventory, Users, Analytics, Procurement, Scan). Verified via automated body-text scan for hardcoded German tokens and raw namespaced translation keys, plus html dir attribute for RTL and localStorage 'rb_lang' persistence.

issues: The full liability waiver body (LIABILITY_WAIVER constant in /app/frontend/src/lib/constants.js) remains hardcoded German in EN and AR ('Haftungsausschluss & Einverständniserklärung: 1. Datenverlust ...'). Only the section heading and waiverTitle label translate; the actual legal contract body does not. This mirrors the printed-contract policy (Invoice/Abholschein/ContractPrint kept German intentionally), so it is likely a conscious legal-document decision. Flagging for main agent to confirm whether the on-screen waiver copy should also be translated (customer reads it before signing). No functional impact.

verified.language_switcher_persistence: localStorage 'rb_lang' persists across reload; dir attribute correctly toggles between ltr (de/en) and rtl (ar).
verified.arabic_rtl_layout: html[dir=rtl] confirmed on Dashboard, Orders, and OrderDetail. Sidebar visually mirrors to the right in Arabic.
verified.no_raw_i18n_keys: Regex scan for namespace.key patterns (detail.*, costs.*, actions.*, dashboard.*, mad.*, oc.*, inv.*, usr.*, ana.*, proc.*, palerts.*, purch.*, scan.*, notif.*, comm.*, chat.*, wa.*, sig.*, cam.*, pstatus.*, toast.*, orders.*, status.*, roles.*, login.*, nav.*, common.*, inspection.*, print.*, reklamation.*, activity.*) returned ZERO raw keys on every page tested in EN and AR.
verified.no_german_leftovers: Scanned each page for 30+ German tokens (Marke, Modell, Fehlerbeschreibung, Geräte-Sperre, Garantie, Kostenaufschlüsselung, Diagnose, Arbeitskosten, Versuchszeit, Freigabe, Abholschein, Aufträge, Neuer Auftrag, Ersatzteile, Analyse, Benutzer, Beschaffung, Scannen, Historie, Bereit, etc.). Only match on any page was 'Bereit' as a substring inside the German waiver body on OrderCreate (see design_issues above).
verified.order_detail_translations: Brand/Model, IMEI, Device lock, Lock value, Fault description, Warranty all translate (EN + AR). Cost breakdown (title, Diagnosis, Labor cost, Attempt time, Net, VAT, Total, Diagnosis fee select, Save costs, Approval: Confirmed/Waiting/Rejected) all translate. Tabs, status badge (Diagnosis), Pickup slip / Full print buttons, QR code section, Assign technician, History all translate.
verified.orders_page: Search placeholder, status dropdown 'All statuses', table column headers, badges translate. All tabs / status labels render in EN and AR.
verified.dashboard_admin: Metric cards (Total orders, Active orders, SLA breaches, Revenue), SLA section 'Spare parts: due today / overdue', Complaints & Warranty section, status distribution all translate.
verified.inventory_users_analytics_procurement_sc: Headers, table columns, buttons, search placeholders, stat cards all translate in EN and AR.
verified.login_page: Hero text, form labels, submit, demo accounts panel (title, show/hide, role labels, descriptions) translate. Arabic renders RTL correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide whether the on-screen LIABILITY_WAIVER body in OrderCreate should be translated per-locale (currently only the section heading translates). Legal waivers are typically kept in the shop's operating language; if intentional, no action needed. Otherwise, add de/en/ar variants of the waiver constant (or move to i18n resource) and read via t().
critical_code_review_comments: de.json/en.json/ar.json (~620 lines each) are well-structured by namespace and complete. Good use of {{interpolation}}.
applyDirection in i18n/index.js correctly sets html dir on language change - verified.
LIABILITY_WAIVER in /app/frontend/src/lib/constants.js is hardcoded German - if translation is desired, move to locales.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested i18n coverage passes; only 1 optional design note re legal waiver body)
